title: Résumé: professional summary
text: Veena Kabe is a Senior Backend Engineer with 12 years of experience across healthcare, financial data, networking and AI products. Strengths include Go, Python, microservices, API design, distributed systems, database optimization and production reliability.

title: Résumé: AjnaLens / B by Lenskart (Apr–Oct 2026)
text: Contributed as part of the backend team to the 0-to-1 smart glasses launch, supporting approximately 600 daily active users. Improved profile retrieval from 4 seconds to 4 ms using Redis and PostgreSQL optimization. Built PII encryption using Google Cloud KMS, per-user keys, AES-256-GCM and HMAC-SHA256 fingerprints. Improved Python asyncio Gemini Live reliability through retries, resumption and fail-safe tracing. Reduced PostgreSQL table count approximately 50% after dependency and usage analysis. Owned voice reminders backend: REST APIs, schema, Gemini tool calling, WebSockets, tests and documentation. Built a non-Gemini speech translation POC with FastAPI, faster-whisper, NLLB-200, MMS-TTS and Silero VAD; observed speech-to-text latency fell from 17–30 seconds to approximately 2.5 seconds with 27 backend tests. Advocated a shared deployment template in a team-led initiative reducing releases from 4 hours to 10 minutes; do not claim sole ownership.

title: Résumé: Weave (Aug 2021–May 2025)
text: Led real-time partner integration for Appointment Scheduling following the TrueLark acquisition. Designed gRPC contracts and Open Dental integration, replacing 15+ minute stale sync cycles and rolling out to 5,000+ customers in 3 months. Built Go synchronization pipelines on Kubernetes handling 2M+ records/day across 5+ healthcare integrations, reducing sync latency 40%. Implemented idempotent writeback, exponential backoff, concurrency control and circuit breaking. Led organization-scoped JWT/RBAC remediation across 4 Go services. Used Goose for backward-compatible database migrations. Led incident analysis reducing recurring incidents 50%; mentored engineers and improved CI/CD deployment cycle time 30%.

title: Résumé: Visible Alpha (Oct 2017–Aug 2021)
text: Software Engineer II, then Senior Software Engineer from January 2020. Built APIs and financial data feeds processing 10M+ records/day. Asynchronous Pub/Sub and Redis pipelines improved throughput 90%. Django Admin operations console reduced engineering dependency for routine tasks approximately 70%. Optimized SQL queries and indexes and standardized Docker deployments, improving release reliability approximately 30%.

title: Résumé: Tejas Networks (Jul 2013–Oct 2017)
text: Engineer R&D then Senior Engineer R&D. Mentored recruits and interns and resolved live issues with cross-functional teams.
